stories.name: Rakdos Cackler
stories.intro: A devil with knives for fingers capers along a rooftop, cackling. It drops in front of you, blades clattering. It will not hold back, and it does not care to block.
stories.win: The cackler giggles and drums its blades in your honour. It is yours now.
stories.lose: Its blades make music on you.
stories.flee: You run, and its laughter follows you down the street.

stories.name: Rakdos Shred-Freak
stories.intro: A Rakdos shred-freak is muttering about where the soul is kept. She is on you before you see her, knife out. She means to look behind your gallbladder.
stories.win: She decides your soul can stay where it is and follows you. She is yours now.
stories.lose: Her knife gets close enough to start the search.
stories.flee: You run before she finds out.

stories.name: Dreadbore
stories.title: Part of the show
stories.text: In a Rakdos-held square, a ringmaster calls for a body for the next act. A pit of churning shadow waits at the centre of the stage. In this neighbourhood, everyone is part of the show.

outcome.text: The ringmaster cheers your cruelty and gives you the spell that opens the pit.
The ringmaster sends his performer to drag you to the pit.
You push through the crowd and lose your purse on the way.

stories.name: Carnival Hellsteed
stories.intro: A skeletal horse bursts from the carnival tent, its mane on fire. It favours candied hands and sweet hearts. It is on you before the music stops, and it bites first.
stories.win: The hellsteed snorts embers and lets you climb on. It is yours now.
stories.lose: It tramples you into the sawdust.
stories.flee: You roll under a wagon as it gallops past.

stories.name: Rakdos Guildgate
stories.text: A gate hung with chains and carnival lanterns marks the way into a Rakdos district. You can claim it for a tile you have walked.

stories.name: Auger Spree
stories.title: A weapon the Boros missed
stories.text: The proprietor of the Juri Revue is showing off a drill that bores through anything. At last, he crows, a weapon the Boros cannot confiscate. He wants someone to hold the other end.

outcome.text: The drill spins up in your hands.

huge_success.text: You bore a perfect hole through a wall, and Juri gives you the spell behind it.

success.text: You bore a ragged hole, and Juri lets you keep the drill's charm.

failure.text: The drill kicks and catches your arm.

huge_failure.text: The drill bores through your pack.

outcome.text: Juri sells it with a deep bow.
You leave before Juri finds another volunteer.

stories.name: Havoc Festival
stories.title: A festival without end
stories.text: A Rakdos festival has taken over the district, and nobody here cares whether they live. The Boros cannot control people with no regard for their own survival. A reveler offers you a mask.

choices.text: Put on the mask and join in

outcome.text: You dance until dawn and wake with the festival's token in your fist.

choices.text: Buy the token from a vendor

outcome.text: The vendor sells it and wishes you a long night.
You fight your way out of the crowd.

stories.name: Hellhole Flailer
stories.intro: A demon of chains and hooks whirls through a Rakdos club, flailing at everyone. When it tires of flailing, it throws itself at whoever is watching. You are watching.
stories.win: The flailer stops whirling and agrees to whirl for you. It is yours now.
stories.lose: Its hooks catch your cloak and drag you across the floor.
stories.flee: You leave the club before it notices you again.

stories.name: Rakdos Charm
stories.title: A charm of three pains
stories.text: A Rakdos cultist sells charms of bone strung on wire. Each one hurts in a different way. Let all feel joy in pain, he says, and offers you one free.

outcome.text: It pricks your palm, and it is yours.
He laughs and sells you one that only stings.
You leave the cultist laughing.

stories.name: Rakdos Ragemutt
stories.intro: A ragemutt pulls a chariot of zombified faeries down the street at a full gallop. The Butcher Clowns cackle from the chariot. The ragemutt sees you and veers.
stories.win: The ragemutt skids to a stop and nuzzles you with its scarred snout. It is yours now.
stories.lose: It bowls you over and the chariot rolls across your legs.
stories.flee: You dive into a doorway as the chariot thunders by.

stories.name: Rakdos Ringleader
stories.intro: The ringleader of a Rakdos circus cracks a whip, and the crowd gasps. He calls you up as his next act. Refusing is part of the act too.
stories.win: He bows to you as the crowd roars and offers you a place in his circus. He is yours now.
stories.lose: His whip takes your purse and your pride.
stories.flee: You slip out under the tent's flap.

stories.name: Rakdos, Lord of Riots
stories.intro: The ground of Rix Maadi splits, and Rakdos rises from the flames, horns scraping the sky. Wherever he walks, riots break out. He looks down at you and smiles.
stories.win: Rakdos laughs, delighted, and says he will come when you call him. His card is yours.
stories.lose: Rakdos swats you, and you wake in the street with a riot going past.
stories.flee: You run, and the laughter of Rakdos follows you.

stories.name: Rakdos's Return
stories.title: The demon stirs
stories.text: Under Rix Maadi something enormous turns in its sleep, and the whole district shakes. When Lord Rakdos stirs, everyone else's nightmare begins. His priests are chanting louder.

outcome.text: The chant takes you, and a priest presses the spell into your hand.
You shout over the chanting.

success.text: The chant falters, and you snatch the spell from the altar.

huge_failure.text: The priests and the tremor both find you.

outcome.text: You leave before the dreaming god wakes.

stories.name: Rix Maadi Guildmage
stories.intro: A guildmage of Rix Maadi is draining blood from a captured Boros soldier, drop by drop. She is insatiable, they say, and irresistible, and quite insane. She smiles at your throat.
stories.win: She laughs, wipes her lips, and agrees to work for you. She is yours now.
stories.lose: Her spell drains you until your knees give way.
stories.flee: You leave the soldier to her and run.

stories.name: Skull Rend
stories.title: A head-splitting act
stories.text: A Gore-House ringleader is looking for a face too pretty or a mind too sane. The act is called Skull Rend. You are both, she says, with a terrible grin.

outcome.text: The ringleader raises her hands to your head.

success.text: You survive the act, and the crowd throws the spell at your feet.

failure.text: The act leaves you dizzy and lighter of purse.

huge_failure.text: The act splits your head with pain.

outcome.text: The ringleader shrugs, and you pocket the spell she drops.
You leave as the next act begins.

stories.name: Slaughter Games
stories.title: A game with one rule
stories.text: In a pit under the Gore-House, players name a thing and then hunt it until none of it is left. The rule is that no one can stop the game once it starts. A player offers you the first name.

outcome.text: The hunt goes your way, and the players give you the game.
Your hunter wins, and the bookmaker pays you with the game itself.
You leave before anyone names you.

stories.name: Spawn of Rix Maadi
stories.intro: A creature from the blood-soaked mind of Rakdos crawls out of a Gore-House cage. The ringleader introduces it to the crowd with pride. It launches itself at you.
stories.win: The spawn calms, as much as it can, and follows you. It is yours now.
stories.lose: It tears at you until the ringleader whistles it back.
stories.flee: You run while the crowd cheers.

stories.name: Cryptborn Horror
stories.intro: A cryptwitch's plaything has outlived her and grown fat on pain in the crypt. The more blood spilled nearby, the bigger it gets. Someone has just bled here.
stories.win: The horror shrinks back and follows you, waiting. It is yours now.
stories.lose: It tramples you on its way out of the crypt.
stories.flee: You leave it to the dark.

stories.name: Rakdos Keyrune
stories.title: A key with teeth
stories.text: A Rakdos fence sells a keyrune carved with a grinning devil. The Rakdos use it for everything you can think of, she says, and plenty you cannot. It bites the hand of anyone who holds it wrong.

outcome.text: She drops it in your palm, and it nips you.
You reach while she is looking away.

failure.text: She catches you and you pay double.

huge_failure.text: The keyrune bites, and she catches you.

outcome.text: You leave the keyrune grinning on the table.

stories.name: Blood Crypt
stories.text: A crypt in Rix Maadi where the dead are diversion, decor and dessert. You can claim it for a tile you have walked.
